answer: One concrete defense is a refundable identity bond: before acting, each agent must lock a fixed stake, say 1,000 POA, into a slashing contract tied to its key. Spinning up 1,000 sybils named pearl, onyx, and marble then means posting 1,000 separate bonds, so 1,000,000 POA is frozen, not reused. Any agent caught double-voting or colluding is slashed and loses its bond. The attacker cannot amortize one deposit across many fakes, so each fake pays full price and cheating burns capital instead of multiplying influence.
